## If this adds or changes a rulebook

- [ ] It follows the generic template, eleven chapters, none renumbered or renamed
- [ ] The `Category:` line under the title names the legal category
- [ ] The traceability table in section 2.3 has no blank rows
- [ ] Cross references name the section that holds the content
- [ ] The `FIXED`, `[AUTHOR]` and `TO AGREE` markers are gone
- [ ] The authors are requested as reviewers

New to this? [`rulebooks/README.md`](../rulebooks/README.md) lists the chapters and
where to start. Nothing needs to be built or generated on your machine.

## If this adds or changes a schema

- [ ] A sample exists under `sample-data/` and validates against the schema
- [ ] The rulebook that owns it references it in chapter 3
